relevance_note: Single-centre thalidomide cohort of 16 children, all with a genetic diagnosis of a monogenic AID, including '2 A20 haploinsufficiency (HA20)' (Table 2 cases 12 and 13); TNFAIP3 and the variants are not named in the main text.
method_note: Read the whole Markdown; values chosen by hand and written to JSON with a short Python script (no automated table transcription); every span checked verbatim by script. Scope: only the 2 HA20 patients (Table 2 rows No 12 and 13, 'HA20^d') are extracted; the other 14 patients have other monogenic AIDs (AGS, Blau, CINCA, DADA2, FMF, PLAID, SAVI, TRAPS) and no TNFAIP3/HA20 diagnosis, so they are not rows. Labels 'Case 12'/'Case 13' follow the paper's 'Case N' convention ('Case 1', 'cases 5 and 12', 'cases 4,12,13') and Table 2 'No' column. No gene symbol, variant string, transcript or zygosity is printed in the main text (genetic details presumably in Additional file 1, not in this Markdown), so the variants table is empty. Table 1 has disease groups as columns; the HA20 column is the 6th data column (after AGS, Blau syndrome, CINCA, DADA2, FMF); spans quote the row from its label through the HA20 cell. HA20 n=2 (Num row). Group inferences (evidence_basis 'inferred from group statement'): Fever 2/2 in the HA20 column -> observed for both (text calls these 'recurrent fevers'); HA20 cells of 0 for Growth or intellectual disability, Cardiovascular, Joint, Eye or ear, Hematologic and Neurologic involvement -> excluded for both; 'None of the patients had adverse events such as peripheral neuropathy and somnolence' -> excluded for both. Checklist mapping: Joint involvement 0 -> arthritis or arthralgia excluded; Eye or ear 0 -> ocular inflammation excluded; Hematologic 0 -> cytopenia excluded (text defines hematological involvement as thrombocytopenia/anemia); Neurologic 0 -> CNS excluded; Growth or intellectual disability 0 -> growth failure excluded. Cardiovascular 0 was NOT used to exclude 'pericarditis or other serositis' (other serositis not covered) or vasculitis. Not attributable (HA20 count 1 of 2, so not recorded per person): female 1 / male 1 (sex left 'not reported'), rash, gastrointestinal involvement, respiratory involvement, hypothyroidism, autoantibody positivity, elevated CRP, elevated ESR, immunosuppressive agent 1, hydroxychloroquine 1. Disease severity of HA20 (Table 2: Case 12 Mild->disease-free; Case 13 Moderate->Mild->disease-free->Moderate->disease-free) kept in treatment_summary, not as phenotypic features. Two previously reported HA20 patients mentioned in one Discussion sentence ('When two For HA20 patients were treated with thalidomide ... [17]') were not made rows: no labels or individual-level detail beyond a shared treatment response; the paper does not say they are cases 12/13 (and cases 12/13 had no glucocorticoids before thalidomide, unlike those patients). cites_prior_report_of_same_patients left null: no statement either way. Contradictions/inconsistencies noted: (1) Discussion says the 2 patients with drug-related side effects had 'nausea, fatigue, and anorexia', whereas Results give only 'anorexia and nausea' for cases 5 and 12; fatigue not recorded for Case 12. (2) 'ESR levels in 16 patients (100.0%) reached the normal ranges' although only nine had elevated ESR at baseline. (3) 'Four patients discontinued thalidomide gradually after reaching 3 months' vs Table 2, where cases 3, 7 and 15 have values beyond 3 months (not HA20 cases). (4) Abstract/Results give 12 patients completing the study with seven having fever at baseline, vs 8/16 with fever in Table 1 (different denominators, not a per-person conflict).
